patent.title: 一种具有美白、抗衰功效的护肤组合物及其应用
assignees: 江苏仅三生物科技有限公司
patent.family_note: Holdout E3-C; granted claims narrowed to tyrosinase-inhibition USE of a multi-ingredient composition.

knowledge_origin.description: Public holdout E3-C cold-start; marketing patent marking on SKU page.

technology.problem: 美白抗衰功效与刺激性、麦角硫因光稳定性之间的配方矛盾。
technology.mechanism: 麦角硫因+VC乙基醚+烟酰胺+谷胱甘肽+透明质酸等协同抑制酪氨酸酶/抗氧化（说明书）；授权权利要求收窄为该组合物在抑制酪氨酸酶活性中的应用。
technology.comparison_baseline: Prior whitening actives in patent background; not independently re-benchmarked.

value_carriers.name: 玻麦妍美白淡斑塑颜水（候选；权利要求核验未通过）
value_carriers.description: Official product page marks invention patent ZL202310277767.8. Claims check FAIL: granted claim 1 requires ergothioneine+VC ethyl ether+niacinamide+glutathione+HA (stated wt% ranges) for tyrosinase-inhibition use; public page discloses ergothioneine, niacinamide, HA narratives but does not publicly establish VC乙基醚 and 谷胱甘肽 within claimed ranges for this SKU. Patent marking ≠ verified claim coverage.

gaps.description: After claims check, public sources do not establish that 玻麦妍塑颜水 practices granted claim 1 (missing public disclosure of VC乙基醚 + 谷胱甘肽 at claimed levels). Marketing patent number alone insufficient.
needed_evidence: Full INCI / quantitative formula matching claim 1 elements
Regulated disclosure that this SKU embodies the claimed use composition

notes: Holdout E3-C. T0=2026-10-13. Claims check: FAIL → no E3 in evidence_levels_present; exact link=unknown; R0. Unknown≠0. Do not auto-R3 from patent sticker. Formal V0.7/schema 1.0; not V0.8.
